summary.headline: Mercury and Venus in Planetary Houses
summary.text: Astrological judgments for Mercury in its own house and in the Moon’s house, including learning, wealth, journeys, bodily ailments, demonic practitioners, and dangers to the eyes and on water. Chapter 40 then begins with Venus in Saturn’s house, predicting relationships with a phlebotomist or prostitutes and accusations of sexual corruption.
